UNKNOWN.normative_meaning: Insufficient, missing, or not-yet-adjudicated CURRENT evidence for a single operator fate. Default fail-closed pin for inventored bypasses until a scoped Operator-GO adjudication assigns another allowed token.
required_evidence_for_assignment: Explicit documentation that evidence is insufficient OR adjudication WP not yet Operator-authorized.

CONFLICTING.normative_meaning: CURRENT authoritative surfaces disagree on the operative end-state for this bypass ID such that no single non-UNKNOWN fate can be assigned fail-closed.
required_evidence_for_assignment: At least two CURRENT canonical pins/contracts with mutually incompatible operative prescriptions for the same bypass ID.
Explicit conflict statement naming both evidence refs.
forbidden_interpretations: Silent preference for one conflicting side.
Runtime rewire to resolve conflict without separate GO.
CONFLICTING.relation_to_crs_mv2_scope: Does not expand or shrink MV2 CRS quantity-algebra ownership.

KEEP_PARALLEL_NON_CANONICAL.normative_meaning: Bypass remains a productive parallel size route; not canonical for MV2 intent-bound CRS scope; consolidation not claimed. Fate pin alone authorizes no rewire.
required_evidence_for_assignment: CURRENT reachability REACHABLE_PRODUCTIVE (or equivalent inventored pin).
CURRENT pin that route is non-canonical for MV2 CRS scope.
Evidence that CURRENT necessary function of the route is to remain available as parallel/non-CRS size decision for its scoped host (classic/offline/execution/shadow as inventored).
forbidden_interpretations: Promotes route to repo-wide canonical owner.
KEEP_PARALLEL_NON_CANONICAL.relation_to_crs_mv2_scope: Preserves parallel non-canonical relation to CRS MV2 scope.

GOVERNANCE_EXCLUDE_FROM_SYSTEM_EVIDENCE.normative_meaning: Bypass must not be treated as size authority for system/economic evidence claims. This is a governance/evidence exclusion intent, not a runtime disable by this freeze.
required_evidence_for_assignment: CURRENT inventored decision-effect showing the route decides size outside CRS.
CURRENT governance need that system/economic evidence must not rely on this route as authoritative size owner.
Explicit statement that runtime disable/quarantine remains a separate Runtime-GO if required.
GOVERNANCE_EXCLUDE_FROM_SYSTEM_EVIDENCE.relation_to_crs_mv2_scope: Does not by itself make CRS repo-wide owner; only excludes this bypass from system-evidence authority claims.

INTEND_REBIND_TO_CRS.normative_meaning: Operator-intended future consolidation/migration of this bypass toward CRS quantity algebra for the relevant scope. Implementation/rewire is not authorized by the fate pin alone.
required_evidence_for_assignment: CURRENT mapping of bypass producer/caller to a CRS-consumable decision surface or explicit rebind target.
Statement that MV2 CRS scope remains as already adjudicated and is not silently expanded by this fate.
Explicit separate Runtime-GO requirement for any rewire/rebind implementation.
INTEND_REBIND_TO_CRS.relation_to_crs_mv2_scope: Migration intent toward CRS; does not change CURRENT MV2 scope adjudication.

RESEARCH_OR_OFFLINE_SCOPE_ONLY.normative_meaning: Bypass is scoped to research/offline/evaluation hosts only for authority claims; not a productive system-evidence size owner. Does not delete code.
required_evidence_for_assignment: CURRENT inventored host/scope showing research or offline-evaluation role.
Evidence that productive system-evidence claims must not rest on this route.
Explicit separate Runtime-GO requirement if enforcement/quarantine wiring is later required.
forbidden_interpretations: Equals KEEP_PARALLEL_NON_CANONICAL for productive system evidence.
RESEARCH_OR_OFFLINE_SCOPE_ONLY.relation_to_crs_mv2_scope: Does not alter CRS MV2 quantity-algebra ownership.
